findings.title: SQL Injection in category parameter leading to admin credential theft
findings.description: The 'category' GET parameter in index.php is vulnerable to SQL injection (boolean-based blind, error-based, time-based blind, and UNION query). This allowed dumping the admins table to obtain admin credentials, which were used to log in and retrieve the flag.
